summary: ZTO Express filed a Form 6-K reporting its unaudited second quarter 2026 financial and operational results. The filing discloses revenue of RMB14,549.9 million, up 23.0% year over year, and adjusted net income of RMB3,086.1 million, up 50.3%. Parcel volume grew 6.5% to 10.5 billion, with market share at 19.9%. This is a routine earnings announcement for a foreign private issuer, not a special-situation event. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, or other corporate action; it is purely a periodic financial disclosure with no deal terms, board actions, or strategic initiatives.
